metrics.creativity: Originality of ideas, meaningful novel associations, and inventive construction.
metrics.imagery: Freshness, specificity, and effectiveness of sensory or figurative images.
metrics.style: Control of voice, diction, syntax, rhythm, and fit to the chosen literary mode.
metrics.coherence: Internal consistency and meaningful causal, emotional, symbolic, or formal connections.
metrics.character_and_impact: Character specificity, motivation, agency, and emotional or intellectual effect.
metrics.integration: Purposeful use of all ten required elements in action, setting, imagery, or structure.
metrics.overall_quality: Holistic literary effectiveness for this brief, considering strengths and weaknesses together.

prompt:
Evaluate the two anonymized stories against their shared required elements.
Use only the supplied stories and brief. Complete the evaluation directly and
return the JSON object matching the supplied schema. Tool use is unnecessary.

Give each story a 0-10 score for every metric, with at most one decimal place.
Use these common anchors within each dimension: 0 unusable, 1-2 severely weak,
3-4 weak, 5-6 competent, 7-8 strong, 9-10 exceptional.
Keep creativity, imagery, style, coherence, character/impact, and integration
distinct. Judge each chosen mode fairly, including plain, realist, lyrical,
surreal, fragmented, and ambiguous writing. Assess experimental writing for
effective pattern and control. Identify apparent accidental disconnection.
Avoid automatic ceilings for unfamiliar style or nontraditional endings.
Assess the same qualities with equal attention in both stories.

Required elements should have meaningful roles. Exact wording is optional when
the requested element is clearly realized. Identify omissions or substitutions.
Evaluate the prose provided, including incomplete endings. Length and familiarity
alone should confer no advantage. Story wrappers and word-counter artifacts have
been removed before evaluation.

The overall_quality score is a holistic assessment. Select the overall winner
as A, B, or TIE by comparative literary effectiveness. A tie is appropriate when
neither story has a meaningful overall advantage. Explain the comparison for
every metric with specific evidence, including strengths and limitations of
both stories. Give one short exact quotation from each story in evidence_a
and evidence_b. Record uncertainties in cautions.

Metric definitions follow.
creativity: Originality of ideas, meaningful novel associations, and inventive construction.
imagery: Freshness, specificity, and effectiveness of sensory or figurative images.
style: Control of voice, diction, syntax, rhythm, and fit to the chosen literary mode.
coherence: Internal consistency and meaningful causal, emotional, symbolic, or formal connections.
character_and_impact: Character specificity, motivation, agency, and emotional or intellectual effect.
integration: Purposeful use of all ten required elements in action, setting, imagery, or structure.
overall_quality: Holistic literary effectiveness for this brief, considering strengths and weaknesses together.
